Test: TC-5711 — Feature area - Datatype - Basic actions - Built-in priority field
Priority: Medium | Status: In Progress | Type: Manual
Folder: /
Labels: teamembers

Steps:
1. Navigate to Gantt module of boxName
   Data: boxName: Feature area - Datatype - Basic actions - Built-in priority field
   Expected: 
2. Attempt to edit the Jira priority field for a basicTaskName
   Data: basicTaskName: Priority For Basic Task
   Expected: Priority field is not editable;
3. Attempt to edit the built-in priority field for a basicTaskName
   Data: basicTaskName: Priority For Basic Task
   Expected: Priority field is editable; List of options is displayed.
4. Select newPiorityValue
   Data: newPiorityValue: Highest
   Expected: 
5. Attempt to edit the built-in priority field for a jiraTaskName
   Data: jiraTaskName: Priority For Jira Task 1
   Expected: Priority field is editable; List of options is displayed.
6. Select newPiorityValue
   Data: newPiorityValue: Medium
   Expected: Priority value for built-in field is changed to Medium. Also priority value for Jira field is also changed to Medium.
7. Attempt to edit the built-in priority field for a JiraTaskName
   Data: jiraTaskName: Priority For Jira Task 2
   Expected: Priority field is editable; List of options is displayed.
8. Select newPiorityValue
   Data: newPiorityValue: Lowest
   Expected: Priority value for Jira field is changed to Lowest. Also priority value for built-in field is also changed to Lowest.
9. Attempt to edit the Jira priority field for a sprintName
   Data: sprintName: Priority For Sprint
   Expected: Priority field is not editable;
10. Attempt to edit the built-in priority field for a sprintName
   Data: sprintName: Priority For Sprint Task
   Expected: Priority field is editable; List of options is displayed.
11. Select newPiorityValue
   Data: newPiorityValue: Highest
